description: ISO 20022 reason codes for v1 rails (RTP, SEPA Instant, SEPA Direct Debit). Single source of truth for the explainer and the fixed-message baseline for evals.
perspective: Our bank is the sending side: the originator's bank for credit transfers (RTP, SEPA Instant) and the creditor's bank for direct debits (SEPA DD). 'Customer' means our customer who sent or collected the payment.
rails_meaning: A rail is listed only when a source below confirms the code in a reject (pacs.002) or return/refund (pacs.004) on that rail. An empty list means the code exists in ISO but no rail use was confirmed.

routes.FIRST_LINE: Platform support resolves it with the customer.
routes.COMPLIANCE: Sanctions, AML and other regulatory stops.
routes.TREASURY: Bank liquidity or prefunded balance issues.
routes.QC: Possible bug from a recent release. Not used as a default route; triggered by a post-release spike (v2).

ISO.title: ISO 20022 External Code Sets (ExternalStatusReason1Code, ExternalReturnReason1Code)
ISO.note: iso20022.org blocked automated download (HTTP 403). Code membership and definitions were checked against an MIT-licensed JSON conversion of the official publication: https://github.com/TransactionAuthorizationProtocol/iso20022-external-code-sets (commit a325faf, May 2025). Re-check against the official file by hand.

EPC_SCT_INST.title: EPC059-18 v7.0 Guidance on Reason Codes for SCT Inst R-transactions (5 Oct 2025)

EPC_SDD.title: EPC173-14 v8.0 Guidance on Reason Codes for SDD R-transactions (28 Nov 2024)

TCH_RTP.title: The Clearing House RTP Customer Documentation: Message Status Report v2.2 (April 2018), Appendix 3.1
TCH_RTP.note: Newest public RTP code list found is from 2018; the current spec may differ. Treat every RTP pairing as 'confirmed as of 2018'.

codes.name: Incorrect Account Number
codes.meaning: The account identifier (IBAN) is invalid or does not exist at the other bank.
codes.baseline_what_happened: The other bank rejected the payment because the IBAN is invalid or does not exist there.
codes.baseline_what_to_do: Ask the customer to confirm the other party's IBAN directly with that party before sending again.
codes.baseline_customer_message: Your payment could not be completed because the other party's account details were not recognised. Please check the account number with them before trying again.
codes.review_note: Not in the RTP list; RTP uses AC03 (creditor account) and AC02 (debtor account) instead.

codes.name: Invalid Creditor Account Number
codes.meaning: The receiving customer's account number is invalid or missing.
codes.baseline_what_happened: The receiving bank rejected the payment because the recipient's account number is invalid or missing.
codes.baseline_what_to_do: Ask the customer to confirm the recipient's account number directly with the recipient before sending again.
codes.baseline_customer_message: Your payment could not be completed because the recipient's account details were not recognised. Please check the account number with the recipient before trying again.
codes.review_note: Added beyond the original 12 so RTP has an invalid-account code. In SEPA Instant, EPC lists AC03 only for a Request for Recall by the Originator, not for rejects, so SEPA_INSTANT is not listed.

codes.name: Closed Account Number
codes.meaning: The other party's account has been closed.
codes.baseline_what_happened: The other bank rejected or returned the payment because the other party's account is closed.
codes.baseline_what_to_do: Ask the customer to get up-to-date account details from the other party.
codes.baseline_customer_message: Your payment could not be completed because the other party's account is closed. Please contact them for their current account details.
codes.review_note: Some SEPA countries forbid this code for data-protection reasons; their banks send MS03 instead.

codes.name: Blocked Account
codes.meaning: The other party's account is blocked for transactions.
codes.baseline_what_happened: The other bank rejected or returned the payment because the other party's account is blocked.
codes.baseline_what_to_do: Tell the customer the other party's account cannot receive or pay this transaction, and suggest they agree another account or payment method with the other party. Do not speculate about why it is blocked.
codes.baseline_customer_message: Your payment could not be completed because the other party's account cannot accept it. Please contact them to agree another way to pay.
codes.review_note: The block is the other bank's decision (e.g. court order or suspected misuse, per EPC), so our first line informs and does not investigate. Customer text deliberately gives no reason.

codes.name: Transaction Forbidden
codes.meaning: This type of transaction is not allowed on the account (SEPA), or the bank is not authorised for this transaction type (RTP).

rail_notes.RTP: When sent by TCH (the RTP network) it means a participant bank is not authorised to send or receive this transaction type: a setup issue, not the customer's account.
rail_notes.SEPA_INSTANT: The account cannot receive SCT Inst transactions.
rail_notes.SEPA_DD: The account does not allow direct debits for regulatory reasons (e.g. a savings account).

codes.baseline_what_happened: The payment was rejected because this type of transaction is not allowed for the account or bank involved.
codes.baseline_what_to_do: SEPA: ask the customer to agree a different account or payment method with the other party. RTP: check whether the rejection came from the network (participant not set up for this transaction type) and pass to the technical team if so.
codes.baseline_customer_message: Your payment could not be completed because this type of payment is not accepted for the account involved. Please agree another way to pay with the other party.
codes.review_note: Meaning differs by rail, hence rail_notes and route_by_rail: the RTP network usage is a participant configuration problem, so it goes to DEVELOPER.

codes.name: Insufficient Funds
codes.meaning: There is not enough money to cover the payment (SEPA DD: in the debtor's account; RTP: in the sending bank's prefunded position).

rail_notes.RTP: Generated by TCH when the sending bank's net position would breach its prefunded balance. It is about the bank's liquidity, not the customer's balance.
rail_notes.SEPA_DD: The debtor's account did not have enough funds for the collection.

codes.baseline_what_happened: The payment failed because there were not enough funds to cover it.
codes.baseline_what_to_do: SEPA DD: tell the customer (the creditor) the debtor's account lacked funds, and suggest they contact the debtor before collecting again. RTP: this is our bank's prefunded position at the network, so pass to treasury; do not ask the customer to add funds.
codes.baseline_customer_message: Your payment could not be completed this time. Please contact us or the other party if you would like to arrange the payment again.
codes.review_note: On RTP it is a bank prefunding breach, so it goes to TREASURY; SEPA DD stays FIRST_LINE. In SCT Inst, EPC lists AM04 only as a negative answer to a recall, not a reject, so SEPA_INSTANT is not listed. Customer message is deliberately neutral because it must fit both meanings.

codes.name: Duplication
codes.meaning: The other bank or the clearing system treated the payment as a duplicate of one sent very recently.
codes.baseline_what_happened: The payment was rejected as a duplicate of an identical payment sent very recently.
codes.baseline_what_to_do: Check whether an identical payment really went through earlier. If it did, no action is needed beyond telling the customer. If it did not, pass to the technical team to find why our system sent a duplicate.
codes.baseline_customer_message: This payment was stopped because it matched one that was already sent. Please check your recent payments before sending it again.
codes.review_note: Routed to DEVELOPER because EPC names technical or human error at the sender as the root cause. A sudden spike after a release suggests a QC case, but that depends on timing, not the code. RTP uses DUPL instead (not in this table).

codes.name: Timeout Creditor Agent
codes.meaning: The receiving bank did not get or process the instant payment within the scheme's time limit.
codes.baseline_what_happened: The instant payment timed out before the receiving bank completed it, so it was not executed.
codes.baseline_what_to_do: Check our connection and processing logs for this payment. Suggest the customer try again later or use a non-instant transfer.
codes.baseline_customer_message: Your instant payment could not be completed because the receiving bank did not respond in time. Please try again later or use a standard transfer.
codes.review_note: Routed to DEVELOPER because EPC names connection, processing or validation issues anywhere in the chain as the root cause. Not in the RTP list; RTP uses DS24 for system timeouts.

codes.name: Waiting Time Expired Due To Incomplete Order
codes.meaning: The RTP network timed out waiting for the payment to complete.
codes.baseline_what_happened: The RTP network timed out before the payment completed, so it was not executed.
codes.baseline_what_to_do: Check our connection and processing logs for this payment. Suggest the customer try again later or use another payment method.
codes.baseline_customer_message: Your instant payment could not be completed because it timed out. Please try again later or use another payment method.
codes.review_note: Added beyond the original 12 because AB05 is not in the RTP list; TCH uses DS24 for system time-out.

codes.name: No Mandate
codes.meaning: There is no valid direct debit mandate, or the debtor says the collection was unauthorised.
codes.baseline_what_happened: The direct debit was rejected or returned because the debtor's bank has no valid mandate for it.
codes.baseline_what_to_do: Ask the customer (the creditor) to check the mandate details and, if needed, get a new signed mandate from the debtor before collecting again.
codes.baseline_customer_message: Your direct debit collection could not be completed because no valid mandate was found. Please check the mandate with the payer before collecting again.
codes.review_note: EPC also uses MD01 for refunds of unauthorised SDD Core transactions. Repeated MD01 refunds on one creditor can be a fraud signal, worth an ops metric later.

codes.name: Refund Request By End Customer
codes.meaning: The debtor used their right to a refund of an authorised SDD Core collection.
codes.baseline_what_happened: The debtor asked their bank for a refund of this direct debit, and the funds were returned.
codes.baseline_what_to_do: Tell the customer (the creditor) the debtor requested a refund, and suggest they contact the debtor to resolve the underlying payment.
codes.baseline_customer_message: The payer has requested a refund of this direct debit and the funds have been returned. Please contact the payer to resolve the payment.
codes.review_note: SDD Core only (not B2B). In EPC terms this is a Refund, which is also carried in a pacs.004.

codes.name: Not Specified Reason Customer Generated
codes.meaning: The other party (the beneficiary or debtor) refused the payment and gave no reason.
codes.baseline_what_happened: The other party instructed their bank to refuse this payment, without giving a reason.
codes.baseline_what_to_do: Ask the customer to contact the other party directly to agree how to settle the payment.
codes.baseline_customer_message: Your payment was declined by the other party. Please contact them directly to agree how to complete it.

codes.name: Not Specified Reason Agent Generated
codes.meaning: The other bank rejected the payment without giving a reason, usually because national privacy law stops it from giving the precise code.
codes.baseline_what_happened: The other bank rejected or returned the payment without giving a specific reason.
codes.baseline_what_to_do: Ask the customer to contact the other party directly to agree how to settle the payment. Do not guess the underlying reason.
codes.baseline_customer_message: Your payment could not be completed by the other bank. Please contact the other party directly to agree how to complete it.
codes.review_note: EPC: used in place of AC04, AM04, MD07, RR01-RR04 where privacy law forbids them, so the true cause may be account, funds or regulatory. Category 'technical' is a placeholder for 'unknown'. Not in the RTP list.

codes.name: Regulatory Reason
codes.meaning: The other bank stopped the payment for a regulatory reason, e.g. a possible anti-money-laundering, sanctions or counter-terrorist-financing hit.
codes.baseline_what_happened: The other bank stopped the payment for regulatory reasons.
codes.baseline_what_to_do: Pass to the compliance team. Do not tell the customer anything beyond the customer message, and do not suggest workarounds.
codes.baseline_customer_message: Your payment could not be completed. Please contact us if you need help.
codes.review_note: Customer text is deliberately vague: AML law (e.g. EU AMLD 'tipping-off' ban) forbids telling a customer that a transaction may be under suspicion or investigation. Not in the RTP list.

codes.name: Fraudulent Origin
codes.meaning: The payment is suspected or claimed to have been initiated fraudulently.
codes.baseline_what_happened: The payment was flagged as possibly fraudulent.
codes.baseline_what_to_do: Pass to the fraud team immediately. Do not retry, refund or contact the other party until the fraud team decides.
codes.baseline_customer_message: We are reviewing this payment. Please contact us if you have any questions.
codes.review_note: In ISO it exists in ExternalStatusReason1Code (and the cancellation reason set). EPC uses FRAD in SCT Inst only as a Recall reason (camt.056), which is outside v1's pacs.002/pacs.004 scope; a successful recall comes back as a pacs.004 with FOCR. Not in the 2018 RTP list. No rail is confirmed for pacs.002/pacs.004, so rails is empty.

codes.name: Fraud
codes.meaning: The payment was returned because of fraud.
codes.baseline_what_happened: The payment was returned because of fraud.
codes.baseline_what_to_do: Pass to the fraud team immediately. Do not retry, refund or contact the other party until the fraud team decides.
codes.baseline_customer_message: We are reviewing this payment. Please contact us if you have any questions.
codes.review_note: Exists in both ISO sets (definition: 'Returned as a result of fraud'). Not found in the EPC SCT Inst or SDD guidance or the 2018 RTP list, so rails is empty.
